full_judgment:
Mr. Syed Mahmud Hossain J:- This criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 04.06.2014 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Divisions in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.3006 of 2010 making the Rule absolute and quashing the proceeding of Special Case No.05 of 2008 arising out of G.R. No.40/2007 corresponding to Madhabpur P.S. Case No.19 dated 18.02.2007 under section 409 of the penal Code and section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 (II of 1947) pending before the Court of Special Judge, Sylhet. 

 On 18.02.2001, one Ahmed Farhad Hossain, Field Officer of the Anti-Corruption Commission (herein after called as 'ACC'), District Office Hobigonj, as informant lodged an FIR with Madhabpur Police Station against accused-respondent No.1 herein, alleging, inter alia, that accused-respondent No.1 is the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Upazila-Madhabpur, District-Hobigonj. He opened a bank account being No.3090 in Bangladesh Krishi .Bank's, Madhabpur Branch. On 28.3.2006, accused-respondent No. I by illegally using his official post deposited an amount of Tk.4.04,9I8/- during the period from, 28.3.2006 to 09.01.2007. Thereafter, he withdrew an amount of Tk.4,00,000/- from that account on 09.01.2007 by a cheque and sent the same to his another account No.11074 of Bangladesh Krishi Bank's Maizdi Court Branch, Noakhali through Telegraphic Transfer (T.T.). On 07.02.2007, he sent Tk.3,50,000/- and Tk.2,00.000/-respectively through two different Telegraphic Transfers (T.Ts.) to the said account of Bangladesh Krishi Bank's Maizdi Court Branch, Noakhali. In total, he sent an amount of Tk.9,50,000/- through his illegal income and as such, he has committed an offence under section 409 of the Penal Code read with section 512) the Prevention of Corruption Act. 1947. During inquiry, it was proved that accused-respondent No.1 by misusing his power took bribe amounting to Tk.9,50,000/- and misappropriated the same. Hence, the case was registered as Madhabpur Police Station Case No.19, under section 409 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act. 1947. 

 4. Therefore, the case record was transferred to the Court of Special Judge, Sylliet for trial and the same was numbered as Special Case No.05 of 2008. After that, on 18.01.2009,
